What we do

One partner for every part of your IT.

Ten staff or a thousand, we can be your whole IT department or back up the team you already have.

Managed IT support

Unlimited help desk by phone, chat and email, with real engineers based in our Seattle office.

  • 24/7 monitoring and alerts
  • Laptop and device management
  • New starter and leaver setup

Cloud services

Move to Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS or Azure without downtime, then keep costs under control.

  • Cloud migration planning
  • Cost reviews and optimisation
  • Backup and disaster recovery

Cybersecurity

Layered protection against ransomware, phishing and data loss, designed around real threats to businesses like yours.

  • Endpoint detection and response
  • Staff phishing training
  • Cyber insurance readiness

Software development

Custom web apps, internal tools and integrations that remove manual work from your processes.

  • Web and mobile applications
  • API and system integrations
  • Legacy system modernisation

Network & infrastructure

Fast, secure Wi-Fi, firewalls and office networks, designed and installed by certified engineers.

  • Office moves and fit-outs
  • Firewall and VPN setup
  • Hardware procurement

IT strategy & consulting

A technology roadmap and budget that matches where your business is going, reviewed every quarter.

  • Virtual CIO service
  • Compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR)
  • Vendor management

Service levels written into your contract.

Onboarding

Switching IT providers in four weeks.

Changing providers sounds painful. We've done it more than 400 times, and our process means no downtime for your team.

Audit

We audit every device, account and system, and document everything your old provider never wrote down.

Secure

Critical security gaps are closed first: backups verified, admin accounts locked down, multi-factor login turned on.

Transition

Monitoring is installed and support moves to our help desk, with a guide sent to every member of staff.

Improve

You receive a 12-month roadmap with priorities, costs and quick wins for the year ahead.

Client testimonial

"We had three outages a month with our old provider. In two years with Northstack we've had none. When something does come up, a real engineer is on it before I've finished my coffee."

Rachel MooreChief Operating Officer, Halcyon Health (140 staff)
Pricing

Fixed monthly pricing, per user.

No surprise invoices and no charge per ticket. Minimum of 10 users; volume discounts from 100 users.

Essentials

$69 /user/month

For small teams that need reliable support.

  • Unlimited help desk (business hours)
  • Device monitoring and patching
  • Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace admin
  • Cloud backup

  • 24/7 help desk and 15-minute response

FAQ

Common questions

What does managed IT services include?

Unlimited help desk support, 24/7 monitoring, security updates, backups, device management and a named account manager, all for one fixed monthly fee per user.

How fast do you respond to support requests?

Critical issues get a response within 15 minutes, 24 hours a day. Standard requests are answered within one business hour. These times are written into your contract.

Can you work with our existing IT team?

Yes. Many clients use our co-managed plan, where we handle monitoring, security and after-hours support while their internal team focuses on projects.

How long does onboarding take?

Most businesses are fully onboarded in two to four weeks, with no downtime during the switch.

Do you support remote and hybrid teams?

Absolutely. We support staff wherever they work, ship pre-configured laptops to new starters and secure home networks.

Get a free IT and security assessment.

In 45 minutes we'll review your systems, highlight your three biggest risks and give you a fixed quote. No obligation.

Call +1 (555) 017-4400 · support@northstack.io
